label: Rework tokens on the latest merged PR
means: Tokens a session spent after a review found something, until its pull request merged, on the newest merged one.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: set 2026-11-04 for the latest merged PR; a tenth of the Claude tab's template goal of 2,000,000 tokens per merged PR, near a quarter
source: pr-link entries of every project folder of params.owners and params.repos, or this repo alone when neither is set, joined with gh api graphql; the linking session's input, output and cache-write tokens after the first pinned review that found something (reviewRounds in blockers.mjs, the reviewer from params.reviewer on targets/blockers.json), until the merge, on the newest merged PR among the last 20 merged linked PRs (params.last.prs); by_repo each repo's newest of its last 20, by project folder; the chart is the repo table. A value read now, never a mean

params.comment: Which repos count: owners (every repo of a GitHub owner) and repos (owner/name); with neither, this repo alone. alias maps a renamed repo's old name to its current one; folder_repos is [pattern, repo] pairs for project folders whose checkout git can no longer find. reviewer is the GitHub login of the pinned review (blockers.json's, when the engine passes every file's params; default any reviewer). plan_file is where a session writes the app's get_usage plan block; empty means plan-usage.json in the repo's data folder (config data, default quality/data). last overrides any N in LAST (tokens.mjs). projects_dir: where Claude Code keeps session transcripts; a ~/ path is under home, an absolute one is itself, any other is under the repo root.

label: Tokens on PRs closed unmerged
means: Of the latest finished pull requests, the share of their sessions' tokens that went to ones closed unmerged.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a PR closed unmerged throws its session's work away, so its tokens bought nothing
source: the last 20 opened linked PRs that merged or closed (params.last.prs; gh api graphql), each with its linking session's input, output and cache-write tokens split evenly over that session's merged and closed PRs; the share on closed ones; by_repo over each repo's last 20, by project folder

label: Weekly plan used now
means: Share of the weekly all-models plan used now, as the app reports it; it resets each week.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: a tenth of the plan's weekly use left for what comes up; near is the plan's whole allowance
source: state: params.plan_file (default plan-usage.json in the repo's data folder), the app's get_usage weekly all-models window as a session last read it: percent of the plan used now; not measured when that read is over a day old

label: Tokens the latest subagent returned
means: How much the latest subagent handed back to the session that asked; a compact result keeps the main context lean.
goal_source: goal from Anthropic, "Effective context engineering for AI agents" (anthropic.com/engineering/effective-context-engineering-for-ai-agents, 2025-09-29, read 2026-11-03): a subagent "returns only a condensed, distilled summary of its work (often 1,000-2,000 tokens)"; near band: template default, twice that; set 2026-11-04 for the latest subagent
source: each subagent transcript's last reply's text at 4 characters a token, which is what it returns to its parent; thinking is never returned, so it is left out (output_tokens, used before 2026-11-04, ran a median 1.8 times this on 191 background Agent results read on 2026-11-03); a reply with no text block counts its output_tokens; the newest of the last 20 subagents to finish (params.last.results), every project folder of params.owners and params.repos, or this repo alone when neither is set; by_repo each repo's newest; detail the five newest. A value read now, never a median

label: Review-fix rounds per merged PR
means: Review rounds that found something to fix, for each merged pull request; each round costs a fix and a re-review.
goal_source: template goal, no public benchmark: one confirming review round plus at most half a round that finds something per PR
source: pinned review rounds that found something (reviewRounds in quality/collectors/blockers/blockers.mjs) over the last 10 merged Claude-linked PRs (params.last.consumption)
